content: Banabasi anà Sↄl bàmasɔↄl, waa bàmatɔm
Kà Ikööŋ a Antyↄsha bàkäl anà aŋangↄↄm anà alɔɔŋ asànaa Banabasi, Simԑyↄ awà bàfàbel Nizyԑr anà Lusyus un'nsi Sirԑn, Manayԑn un'sam a Ɛlↄdi fà imbԑy, anà Sↄl.
Mpal bàkäl ba musyäŋà Mwol anà mukin mbɔr, Dweelà In'kyԑԑl kàtԑn naa: « Lasi Banabasi anà Sↄl ukↄl, ntↄn mukyer isal kabel mԑ. »
Abun, ungö ukin mbɔr anà uyamà, ba basi an'kↄↄ, waa bapɛ mbwo mukyà.
Banabasi anà Sↄl kà Isaŋ a Shipԑlɛ
Wɛɛ akà Banabasi anà Sɔl, Dweelà In'kyɛɛl katöm nde, ba bàtyà Sԑlusi, akun ba bàwԑl an'swà mukyà isaŋ a Shipԑlɛ.
Mpal bàtöl ba u Salamin, ba bàkyäänà ndaa a Nzam uboo a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà. Ywan kàkäl anà ba sye ntɔn mukabay.
Ungö mulyaaŋ uboo a isaŋ kyanswà tii u Pafↄsi, ba bàbweey anà un'kyeer a inwɛŋ mwԑy, ŋangↄↄm a loor wà un'yudà, ikↄb ande Bar Yԑsu,
nde kàkälà tsütsü a Pawulus Sԑrzyus, mfum a Isaŋ a Shipԑle. Nde kàbel Banabasi anà Sↄl ntↄn mukakyään naa nde we anà ngyal muwem Ndaa a Nzam.
Wԑԑ un'kyeer a inwɛŋ Ԑlimasi, ayi mbuul a ikɔb ande, laa kàtön nde, ntↄn nde ndaa aba kakyeyà anki, nde kàleŋà naa mfum ukɔɔn akal anà làkwikilà.
Apan, Sↄl awà bàfàbel sye Pↄl, awà kàkäl aŋàyↄl a Dweelà In'kyɛԑl, kun'paam mii,
waa kàtɛn naa: « Ngye awàŋàyↄl a an'yeerà anà an'kyän an'be, mwan a ileŋ, un'yiiŋ a ndaa a balàbal yanswà, taaŋ nà ngye asàwԑy mubääm an'kyän a balàbal mà Mwol?

Wԑԑ papanà, wem: Mwol akyer akam un'swaŋ, ngye abulà ikwàmii, u ndam a an'taaŋ, ngye mwäänà aman anki. » Utaaŋ nsil alan, un'böŋ anà làpib myun'bweel u mii, nde kàbulà muyoyoolà, wàmuyileŋ naa mbuur kun'twääl u kↄↄ.
Undiir awun, mpal kàmԑn mfum ndaa yàlyaaŋ yi, nde kàsi làkwikilà, ntↄn an'lɔɔŋ a Mwol màkyer un'bilà ubwaŋàbwaŋ.
Pↄl anà Banabasi u Antyↄsha a Pisidi
Pↄl anà baar bàyikyeenà anà nde, bàwԑl an'swà u Pafɔs ntɔn mukyà Pɛrzɛ u Pamfili. Ywan kàkaabà anà ba, waa kàfurà Yԑlusàlԑm.
Wԑԑ ba, ba bàläb mbwo aba: bàlwomà ba u Pԑrzɛ, ba bàkyen Antyↄsha u Pisidi. Ilä a saba, ba bàbilà u ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà, waa bàbwaay.
Ungö mutaŋ un'kɔɔn anà aŋangↄↄm, amfum a ndwà a nköŋ a Ayudà balɔ̈ɔ̈m naa: « Atↄŋ, kya isàkal naa bԑ làbye anà undiir atԑn akà baar ntↄn mukalɛɛl, làtԑn! »
Apan, Pↄl waa kàmbarà, kàswɛŋ isii a kɔɔ, waa kàtԑn naa: « Bԑ baar a Isàlԑl anà bԑ bumwԑy làfàtiin Nzam bↄↄmà, làwem!
Nzam a un'sԑŋ a Isàlԑl wà, kàsɔ̈ɔ̈l bàtaa abi. Nde kàbuul wa wàkölàköl mpal kàkäl wa u mɛɛn a Ngipiti. Wԑԑ u ngwal a kↄↄ ande, nde kun'twey kwo.
Wԑԑ nde ba kasyen kà isii a mbul an'kwem an'nà mpal bàkäl ba u nsye a ipↄl.
Ungö, kàmay nde in'sԑŋ nsambwaar u mɛɛn a Kanana, nde kakääb mԑԑn mukal un'naaŋ aba
kà isii a mbul nkam nà a an'kwem an'tyeen. « Ungö apan, nde kapԑ ntɛɛn tii utaaŋ a ŋangↄↄm Sàmwel.
Wɛɛ semà apan, ba bàlöm mfum, kyakin Nzam kapԑ nde Sawul, mwan a Kisi, umwԑy uboo a mbil a Bԑnsàmԑn. Nde kàyaal mbul an'kwem an'nà.
Wԑԑ ungö, Nzam waa kun'tön, waa kàtwey David mukal mfum aba. Ntɔn nde, nde kàtɛ imbäl ki: "Mԑ aman David, mwan a Yɛsɛ, mbuur kan'kwen mpem amԑ, nde ayakyerà ndaa yanswà in'kwen mԑ."
Unsà ikyee ande, Nzam kàtwey Yԑsu, Un'tswää a mɔ̈ɔ̈ a Isàlԑl, asànaa kàpɛ nde ilää.
Kusà a ngyeel ande, Ywan kàlɔŋ un'sԑŋ a Isàlԑl wanswà ndüümà a mbuul a mpem.

Wԑԑ mpal kàkäl Ywan mumay isal ande, nde kàtɛɛnà naa: "Bԑԑ làsii naa mԑ in'wà nà? Mԑ kà in'wà mbuur làdilà bԑ anki! Wԑԑ làwem: we anà mbuur ayàyà ungö amԑ, mԑ in'kwe anki musɔↄl idyäär kà in'kɔl ande." »
« Atↄŋ abaal, baan a ywar a Abàlam, anà bԑ bumwԑy làfàtiin Nzam bↄↄmà, Ndaa a mɔ̈ɔ̈ ayi bàtöm akà bi.
Wɛɛ abun, baar a Yԑlusàlԑm anà amfum aba, bun'kyey anki Yԑsu. Wɛɛ mpal bun'tsüül ba mbar, ba bàkwey ndaa a aŋangↄↄm bàfàtaŋ saba lanswà.
Wɛɛ, itàkal ba bàmɛn anki undiir ban'kwo mukun'dwa, ba bàlɔ̈m akà Pilatu mulwom mɔ̈ɔ̈ ande.
Ungö bàmay ba mukyer ndaa yanswà bàsön ntↄn nde, ba bun'tↄɔl u kulunsi, waa bun'tɔ̈ɔ̈l uboo a an'dii mwɛy.
Wԑԑ Nzam kun'twey uboo a akü,
nde kàyàmԑnà ilä mbɔɔn akà baar abà bàbeenà anà nde, sԑmà Ngalilԑ tii Yԑlusàlԑm. Ŋàbawà ba bà ambäl ande kusà a un'sԑŋ a Isàlɛl!
Wɛɛ bi, bi ikàlakyäänà Ndaa Aŋàbwaŋ yi: ilää kàpԑ Nzam akà bàtaaràbi,
nde kya kan'kölà ubwaŋàbwaŋ apanà ntↄn bi baan aba, muwiy Yԑsu, asànaa bàsön uboo a diim làyweel naa:
Nzam kun'wiiy uboo a akü, ntɔn nde ukɔↄn afàfurà unsà upɔɔn. Abun nde kàtԑn naa:
Undiir awun kàfàtԑn nde kà itiir a ndaa asin:

content.text: "Ngye asàpà anki mbwo naa mbuur angye wà in'kyɛԑl upɔ̈ɔ̈n."

content: Wɛɛ, David, utaaŋ ande, nde kàsyääl ukwen a Nzam. Ungö, waa kàkü, ba bun'dye kà an'dii a bàtaarànde, nde kàkyer apↄↄn.
Wԑԑ mbuur kàwiiy Nzam, nde kàpɔ̈ɔ̈n anki.
Undiir awun, atↄŋ, làyöb naa u mbwo ande bàkyàlakyään ndwääl a nkul.
U mbwo ande, mbuur wanswà awà wasà làkwikilà atoo wàbalàbal unsà indiir byanswà mpa kàkwe un'kↄↄn a Mↄsԑ mukyer.
Kyakin, làkäl kà igyɛԑŋ manà ndaa bàtԑn aŋangɔɔm iyàlabweel:

content.text: ntɔn mԑ in'kyer undiir mpal làwà bɛ anà mɔ̈ɔ̈, undiir mpa lan'kwo bԑ mukyey isàkal naa mbuur mwԑy kàmàlakyään wa!" »

content: Mpal bàtoo Pↄl anà Banabasi, ba balɔ̈ɔ̈m muyàlɔŋ ndaa nsil ayin u saba làlääb.
Ungö a nköŋ, Ayudà mbↄↄn anà baar bàkyey inzaam a Ayudà, ba bàläb Pↄl anà Banabasi. Ba bàyäämà ba a ba, waa bapɛɛ un'kaay mubääb anà kab angway a Nzam.
Ilä a saba kyàlääb, bul lanswà làkàköŋ ntↄn muwem Ndaa a Mwol.
Wԑԑ mpal bàmԑn Ayudà in'sԑŋ ami, ba bàwem un'köl, bàtön ndaa a Pↄl, waa bun'bɛyà.

Wԑԑ Pↄl anà Banàbasi bàtɛn a uyɔl naa: « Ya yàlɔ̈m naa ndaa a Nzam bàtàkyään bԑ. Wԑԑ, ntɔn lan'tↄn bɛ ya, bԑ ŋakwo lan'swaŋ naa bԑ làkwe anki muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye. Apanà bi ntabwey abi ibuul akà baar mpa abà Ayudà.
Abun, Mwol kà iswԑŋ abà:

content.text: "Mԑ ngye kasi pԑԑlà ntɔn baar mpa abà Ayudà,

content: Wԑԑ mpal bàwem baar mpa abà Ayudà ndaa ayi, ba bàmɛn un'sak, ba bàsɛmà musà ndaa a Mwol làkoo. Baar banswà basɔ̈ɔ̈l muwal mɔ̈ɔ̈ a mbul a in'tye, ba bàsi làkwikilà.
Abun, ndaa a Mwol yàpää kà itiir a nsi akin kyanswà.
Wԑԑ Ayudà bàkàkul usey akà akaar aŋun'naaŋ bàfasyäŋà Nzam anà akà abyääl a bul, ba bàsiinà baar mupà Pↄl anà Banabasi nkwaaŋ, ba baböŋ kà itiir a nsi aba.
Apan, ba bàkyen Ikɔn bàmusakɔɔb un'twà a in'kɔl aba.
Wԑԑ akà alↄŋki, ba bàkäl aŋàyↄl a un'sak anà Dweelà In'kyɛԑl.
